scope: Six CLI/card functionality smokes at checkpoint06d470409 only. No variance improvement, root-distance accuracy, new native-host milestone, or event-processing validation is claimed.

instructions: Use the pinned repository checkout and its documented build environment plus Symbolica license. Build the release gammaloop CLI; a rebuild need not reproduce the recorded executable hash.
Use the repository-relative massive_kite.dot below. Write the embedded double-box DOT into a fresh reproduction directory.

Write each state generation_card_reproduction_toml, replacing @REPRO_ROOT@ with that directory. Run its generation_argv from the repository root to generate all orientations and threshold counterterms.

Materialize smoke_card_template by literal UTF-8 replacement of every token using each run card_bindings. For portable execution, choose new workspace paths and point -s to the corresponding regenerated state; the original recorded argv and hashes remain provenance, not expected regenerated checksums.

Run each CLI with power=1, n_start=n_max=64, seed=101 and one core in read-only-state/no-save-state mode. Supply the Symbolica license via the environment. No more than the six recorded cases are needed.
Check integration_result.json neval=64, both finite complex components, the displayed orientation keys below and saved physical settings. These small runs establish functionality only.
reproduction.smoke_card_template:
# Prepared only: use a freshly gated native-sampling milestone binary.
# Strong focusing (power>1) remains gated on signed-distance root certification.
commands = ["run configure", "display integrand -p @PROCESS@ -i default"]

[[command_blocks]]
name = "configure"
commands = ["""set process -p @PROCESS@ -i default string '
[general]
evaluator_method = "SummedFunctionMap"
[subtraction]
disable_threshold_subtraction = false
[sampling]
graphs = "monte_carlo"
orientations = "summed"
sampling_multichanneling = true
sampling_channels = "monte_carlo"
sampling_channel_weight = "map_density"
coordinate_system = "spherical"
mapping = "linear"
b = 1.0
power = $(power:2.0)
default_channel_selection = @SELECTION_TOML@
[sampling.channel_definitions.@PROCESS@.C]
around = "surface(@SURFACE_EDGES@)"
parent_lmb = @PARENT_LMB_TOML@
subspace_lmb = @PARENT_LMB_TOML@
[integrator]
integrated_phase = "real"
n_start = $(n_start:2000)
n_increase = 0
n_max = $(n_max:10000)
seed = $(seed:101)
n_bins = 16
min_samples_for_update = 64
continuous_dim_learning_rate = 0.25
discrete_dim_learning_rate = 0.25
train_on_avg = false
[integrator.observables_output]
format = ["json"]
[stability]
check_on_norm = true
rotation_axis = [{ type = "euler_angles", alpha = 0.1, beta = 0.2, gamma = 0.3 }]
levels = [
 { precision = "Double", required_precision_for_re = 1e-6, required_precision_for_im = 1e-6, escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = -1.0 },
 { precision = "Quad", required_precision_for_re = 1e-10, required_precision_for_im = 1e-10, escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = -1.0 },
 { precision = "Arb", required_precision_for_re = 1e-12, required_precision_for_im = 1e-12, escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = -1.0 },
]
'"""]

[[command_blocks]]
name = "integrate"
commands = [
 "run configure",
 """integrate -p @PROCESS@ -i default --n-cores $(cores:1)
 --workspace-path $(workspace:@DEFAULT_WORKSPACE@)
 --restart --renderer tabled --show-phase both
 --show-max-weight-info --show-max-weight-info-for-discrete-bins
 --show-top-discrete-grid --show-discrete-contributions-sum
 --write-results-for-each-iteration --batch-timing 2""",
]

kite.original_vs_repository_difference: Whitespace only; removing whitespace makes the texts identical.

kite_rest.generation_card_reproduction_toml:
commands = [
  "import model scalars-default.json",
  "set model mass_scalar_1=1.0",
  "import graphs tests/resources/graphs/massive_kite.dot -p massive_kite -i default -o",
  "generate existing -p massive_kite -i default",
  "display integrand -p massive_kite -i default",
]
[cli_settings.global.generation]
override_lmb_heuristics=true
[cli_settings.global.generation.uv]
subtract_uv=false
generate_integrated=false
[cli_settings.global.generation.threshold_subtraction]
enable_thresholds=true
check_esurface_at_generation=true
[cli_settings.global.generation.evaluator]
compile=false
store_atom=true
summed=false
summed_function_map=true
iterative_orientation_optimization=false
[default_runtime_settings.general]
evaluator_method="SummedFunctionMap"
integral_unit="none"
[default_runtime_settings.kinematics]
e_cm=5.0
[default_runtime_settings.kinematics.externals]
type="constant"
[default_runtime_settings.kinematics.externals.data]
momenta=[[5.0,0.0,0.0,0.0],"dependent"]
helicities=[0,0]
[default_runtime_settings.subtraction]
disable_threshold_subtraction=false
[default_runtime_settings.sampling]
graphs="summed"
orientations="summed"
sampling_multichanneling=false
sampling_channels="summed"
coordinate_system="spherical"
mapping="linear"
b=1.0

orientation_key_proof.ids: contiguous zero-based IDs, matching array positions
orientation_key_proof.source: display integrand on the same loaded process before integration
